name: A coordinator role and personal-agent grant for approvals and the web merge slot
aliases: take and release the merge slot
summary: Coordinator roles and personal-agent grants supply reviews.approve and coordinate while the account holds them; worker credentials do not. Agents never approve their own party. The endpoint table binds action/operation to required capability and project; slot mismatches are refused before tracker or authority reads. One verified_web_authority helper checks configured live authority. GET slot reads native holder/context. Take/release use coordinate and bound usr_/agent_ names; force-release with expected holder/reason and explicit repair need a signed-in owner or superuser, never an agent. Native context/guarded receipts/web audit are reused. No silent creation; missing/damaged slots have recovery. Stable retries cannot release a later holder; each write saves deduplicated project/task/actor/opid/before-after audit before its HTTP receipt. Page and named client ship together; repeated uncertain repairs keep their retry. Host answers and independent_approval remain. Approved .261 is integrated in the accepted base; unknown table actions and second-process authority remain separate. No facts/integration action/provenance/new store/switch.
